# Bare returns must check the actual result bindings, including containment.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./direct
stderr '"rule_id":"correctness::region_escape"'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./holder
stderr '"rule_id":"correctness::region_escape"'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./nested
stderr '"rule_id":"correctness::region_escape"'
logos run ./safe
stdout '^ok named-result-region-controls$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/regionnamed

go 1.27

-- direct/direct.lgo --
package direct

import "logos/arena"

func Leak() (out arena.Region) {
	r := arena.Open()
	out = r
	return
}

-- holder/holder.lgo --
package holder

import "logos/arena"

type box struct { r arena.Region }

func Leak() (out *box) {
	r := arena.Open()
	out = &box{r: r}
	return
}

-- nested/nested.lgo --
package nested

import "logos/arena"

type box struct { r arena.Region }
type wrapper struct { b *box }

func Leak() (out *wrapper) {
	r := arena.Open()
	b := &box{r: r}
	out = &wrapper{b: b}
	return
}

-- safe/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/arena"
)

type box struct { n int }

func named() (out *box, n int) {
	r := arena.Open()
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 3)
	s[2] = 7
	out = &box{n: s[2]}
	n = len(s)
	return
}

func explicit() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 2)
	return len(s)
}

func main() {
	b, n := named()
	if b.n != 7 || n != 3 || explicit() != 2 {
		panic("safe region result changed")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok named-result-region-controls")
}
